load_shader_from_file: load and compile a GLSL vertex or fragment shader from a file into an OpenGL shader object
create_program_from_shaders: create an OpenGL program by linking a list of compiled shader objects together
find_shader_file: find a shader file by searching the local data directory and the module's global data directory
review_loadShader: review the loadShader function to understand how it compiles GLSL shaders and reports compilation errors
refactor_createProgram: refactor the createProgram function to add shader cleanup or custom error handling for link failures
